parts:
If what you are reporting is the Log of the likelihood, that is=20
maximized and -4606 is greater than -4608 which means in terms of=20
deviance, the with strata model fits better than the no strata model. =20
However, that deviance difference is not greater than the added number=20
of parameters.

--jeff
